comparison.objective: Push two foam protectors fully onto the bare corners of a supported picture frame.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a compliant L-shaped pocket along two edges while bracing the loose frame.
comparison.success_condition: Both protectors seated within 4 mm, square/level within 6°, gripping the frame, released and stable; frame or existing-protector disturbance fails.
comparison.reason: Both require alignment and protection against collateral movement, but this tests compliant press-fitting rather than axial impact fracture and fragment containment.
